description: Full UAF write on a freed 64-byte kmalloc object. All 64 bytes are attacker-controllable, enabling overwrite of any replacement object's fields. Typical trigger: allocate object via msgsnd, free it, then spray with target structures via pipe()/open().

Partial UAF write (first 8 bytes only) on a freed drill_cache object. Only the function pointer at the start of the replacement object can be overwritten. Trigger: drill_mod.ko frees a drill_item then writes to stale pointer.

Out-of-bounds write starting 8 bytes before end of a 96-byte slab object, extending 16 bytes past the object boundary into the adjacent slab object. The last 8 bytes of the source object and first 16 bytes of the next object are corrupted.
